title: Kanoe sandbox extensions to AgAPI v1.0 (CR 60) — ADDITIVE ONLY: messages.send_email, calendar.add_event · CR 69: magellan.read_site · CR 72: subscriptions.* · CR 73: registry.* (wave 0) · CR 74: cards.*

line.description: Fixed wording (agapi/powers.py ACTIVITY_LINES) — never a provider's or a person's words.

activity_item.description: CR 64: the Keep's rows, in the SAME shape as 1.1 activity.list's items (whose kind enum predates the Keep: proposed to EU for 1.2). The demo's Activity view merges both, newest first.

masked.description: Never the value: the type's public words and at most the last third (≤4 characters) of its number.

keep_put_in.description: CR 63: save a number or code to the person's Keep. The value is encrypted under the person's own key and never returned, logged or hashed plainly. Card numbers, one-time/2FA codes and passwords are refused.

masked.description: Never the value: the type's public words and at most the last third (≤4 characters) of its number.

keep_use_in.description: CR 63: 'fill' binds the item to a booking (hold_id) and returns a fill token — never the value; code fills it at the moment of use. Tier 'yes' re-issues the hold's read-back so the booking's yes names it. 'show' sends a read-back-only item to the person's own phone, once. Any other purpose (raw, value, reveal…) is refused: never_raw.

keep_delete_in.description: CR 63: one item, or (no item_id) everything — the items and the person's wrapped key, so every value is shredded.

framing.const: Information from your cards' own terms. You decide.
